newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks a shade stronger in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks a shade stronger in early trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were a shade stronger in early Thursday morning trade, despite a sharp fall on Wall Street overnight, brokers said. But they added that profit-taking pressure was strong above the 18,000 level and gains above the threshold could be short-lived.
As of 0029 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was 98.21 points or 0.54 percent higher at 18,135.51. Its June future were up 50 points at 18,100.
"There are few direction-yielding factors, but the market ended on a firm tone on Wednesday the downside should be shallow," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
